title: The Old Light F3 - Intermission
_note: Old Light floor 3, the tea-urn rest floor (pearlmoor_oldlight_3). The same theme as an interval-music lounge number: transposed to Bb major, the eighths swung to triplet feel, a breathy flute lead that SCOOPS up a semitone into every long note (the woozy bit), a walking bass with chromatic approaches, soft organ 7th chords, brushed hats. Where F1 laughs, the vibes (bell) give two sleepy "heh"s and the tea-urn hisses up to the boil (a rising noise swell). 100 BPM, 4/4 swung, Bb major, 24 bars; the walking bass approaches bar 1's Bb from bar 24.
